title: Ambrosia blucon - No pairing with bluetooth
body:
On Sunday i tried to connect a blucon sensor with "xDrip - Nightly build 7th Oct 2017".
The connection was not possible, because the window of the bluetooth code was not popping up.

comments.body: Try the Oct 10th nightly, I think this should fix the problem for you
I assume this is now resolved

Hallo NightscoutFoundation,
Many thanks for your efforts.
I don't testet it again, because I'm using now my former version from 09.09.2017.
On next monday i will see, then i am going to set a new sensor for my son.
But I confide in you, that the problem is now fixed.
Thank You so much for Nightscout.Now it is much easier and simple to observe the glucose of our son in the night and at school.
Kind regardsAlexandra and Klaus
